description: This file contains a series of test cases and setup functions for testing the fanout behavior of git notes in a Git repository. It performs operations such as creating notes, checking fanout consistency, and removing notes, in order to verify automatic fanout restructuring.

methods.name: path_has_fanout
methods.description: Checks if a given path has the specified fanout structure.

methods.name: touched_one_note_with_fanout
methods.description: Determines if a specific note, identified by commit and modification type, has a certain fanout structure.

methods.name: all_notes_have_fanout
methods.description: Verifies that all notes in a specific commit have the specified fanout.
